articles.summary: We may be closer than many think. Advances in AI are transforming power development and collapsing processes that once took months into minutes. That speed unlocks profound change: it lowers the barrier to entry for new developers, accelerates the pace of power buildout, and helps the U.S. meet surging AI-driven energy demand and national targets.
articles.title: The one-person, billion-dollar power development company

articles.summary: Power developers and data center developers are entering a new era of infrastructure buildout. One where site screening, interconnection feasibility, and permitting diligence determine who wins. In this post, we share three predictions for 2026 based on what we’re seeing across energy development workflows, power availability constraints, and development risk analysis.
articles.title: Three predictions for power development in 2026
